skill.name: aws-secrets-rotation
skill.description: Plan and implement AWS Secrets Manager rotation for databases, API keys, and credential audits.
skill.summary: Guides AWS Secrets Manager rotation workflows, Lambda examples, monitoring, and compliance checks.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most command and documentation-link findings are Markdown example false positives, but the skill contains real sensitive handling patterns. Confirmed risks include copyable SSH private key storage examples, Stripe key rotation calls that use secret material, and a URL that embeds an old API key during revocation.

remediation.issue: Copyable SSH private key path in the setup example.
remediation.suggestion: Replace ~/.ssh/id_rsa with a clearly fake placeholder path and add guidance for access control, encryption, and file permissions.

remediation.issue: API key revocation example places an old key value in a URL.
remediation.suggestion: Use provider-supported key identifiers when possible, avoid placing secret values in URLs, and document logging controls.

remediation.issue: Third-party API rotation examples perform live create, test, and delete operations.
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run guidance, explicit non-production testing steps, provider-specific error handling, and rollback checks.

remediation.issue: Examples use production-style secret names and live-key placeholders.
remediation.suggestion: Use neutral placeholder names and warn users to replace all identifiers before running commands.

content.value_statement: Manual credential rotation is slow and error-prone across databases, APIs, and services. This skill provides AWS Secrets Manager workflows, Lambda examples, audits, and emergency rotation guidance.
actual_capabilities: Shows AWS CLI commands to create, retrieve, rotate, and describe Secrets Manager secrets.
Provides Python Lambda examples for RDS credential rotation and API key rotation.
Includes Bash and Python audit workflows for rotation schedules and compliance reporting.
Demonstrates CloudWatch alarm setup for rotation failure monitoring.
Shows Python and Node.js patterns for application secret retrieval.
Lists operational practices for planned and emergency rotations.
limitations: Provides guidance and sample code; it does not deploy infrastructure by itself.
Requires AWS permissions, Secrets Manager setup, and environment-specific testing.
Third-party API rotation examples need service-specific validation and error handling.
Examples use placeholder production names that must be replaced before use.

use_cases.title: Implement Database Rotation
use_cases.description: Create an AWS Secrets Manager rotation plan for RDS credentials with Lambda validation and monitoring.

use_cases.title: Rotate Third-Party API Keys
use_cases.description: Design a controlled workflow for creating, testing, promoting, and revoking external service keys.

use_cases.title: Audit Rotation Compliance
use_cases.description: Review secrets for enabled rotation, overdue schedules, and missing operational controls.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Basic Rotation
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for one managed database secret.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan AWS Secrets Manager rotation for one RDS MySQL credential. Include required inputs, IAM permissions, test steps, and rollback checks.

prompt_templates.title: Create Rotation Lambda
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate implementation for custom rotation logic.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a rotation Lambda design for my database secret. Explain each rotation step, validation requirement, CloudWatch alert, and deployment precaution.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Secret Rotation
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Secrets Manager rotation posture. Identify secrets without rotation, overdue rotations, weak schedules, and monitoring gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Design Emergency Rotation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced incident response after credential exposure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an emergency AWS secret rotation runbook for a suspected credential compromise. Include containment, validation, communication, and post-incident checks.

output_examples.input: Set up automatic rotation for my RDS credentials.
output: A required input checklist for the database secret, Lambda role, rotation schedule, and test environment.
A step-by-step rotation plan covering creation, validation, promotion, alarms, and rollback.
Warnings about testing in non-production before enabling production rotation.

output_examples.input: Audit all secrets for rotation compliance.
output: A compliance summary showing enabled rotation, overdue rotations, and secrets that were never rotated.
A prioritized remediation list for missing schedules, missing alerts, and weak operational ownership.
Recommendations for documenting exceptions and tracking follow-up actions.

output_examples.input: Create an emergency rotation plan for a compromised API key.
output: A response sequence that creates a replacement key, validates it, updates dependent services, and revokes the exposed key.
Verification steps for application health, audit logs, alerts, and incident records.
A reminder to coordinate with service owners before destructive key changes.

best_practices: Test every rotation workflow in a non-production account before enabling it for production secrets.
Use least-privilege IAM roles and monitor all rotation failures with actionable alerts.
Document owners, schedules, rollback steps, and emergency contacts for each managed secret.
anti_patterns: Do not copy placeholder production secret names or live key examples directly into a real account.
Do not rotate or revoke third-party keys before dependent applications are updated and tested.
Do not store private SSH keys without strict access controls, encryption policy, and audit requirements.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy AWS resources automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands, code examples, checklists, and review guidance for a user-controlled deployment.

faq.question: Which secret types does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers RDS credentials, API keys, OAuth tokens, SSH keys, and custom credentials managed through AWS Secrets Manager.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance reporting?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes audit patterns for rotation status, overdue schedules, and secrets that lack rotation.

faq.question: Does it support third-party API keys?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a Stripe-style example, but each provider needs its own tested rotation and revocation logic.

faq.question: What permissions are required?
faq.answer: The workflow needs appropriate AWS Secrets Manager, Lambda, CloudWatch, and service-specific permissions.

faq.question: What should I review before production use?
faq.answer: Review IAM scope, secret names, rotation schedules, application compatibility, logging, rollback steps, and incident procedures.
